'''Breechloaders''' were primitive [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]]. The [[Yapi]] tribes on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]] utilized breechloaders as their primary form of ranged weapon.
